sentences.text: This is an application under Section 389(2) of the CrPC praying for suspension of sentence and for allowing the applicant/petitioner to go on bail during pendency of the appeal.
3. The charges brought against the applicant are under Sections 376(3) of the Indian Penal Code read with Section 511 of the said Code and under Section 8 of the POCSO Act.

4. At the end of the trial, the trial court found the applicant/petitioner guilty and sentenced him to undergo 3 years of rigorous imprisonment and to pay fine of Rs.20,000/- with default stipulations for the offence under Section 8 of the POCSO Act only.
5. In her statement under Section 164 CrPC, the victim girl had stated that the applicant/petitioner had forcibly hugged her with sexual intention.
She further stated that she managed to push aside the petitioner.
6. In her evidence, the victim girl had stated that the applicant/petitioner had touched her private parts while hugging her.
She further stated in her evidence that she slapped the applicant/petitioner and thereafter, went to the house of another woman.
7. In view of the material available in the record, this Court is of the opinion that the applicant/petitioner does not deserve to be detained in custody till the disposal of the appeal.
Therefore, his bail application is allowed.
Page No.# 3/3 8.

The applicant/petitioner Anowar Ali is allowed to go on bail of Rs.25,000/- with a surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Special Judge, Majuli, Assam in connection with Special Case No.05/2022.
The Interlocutory Application (Criminal) stands disposed of accordingly.
